videos.title: James May's Big Trouble in Model Britain
videos.description: Hornby director Simon Kohler assesses the decline of his beloved company, and master modeller Jim is given the biggest build of his modelling life.

videos.title: James May's Big Trouble in Model Britain
videos.description: Hornby number two Simon Kohler takes on two of his biggest rivals in a dramatic showdown, and the company hires its first female product designer.

videos.title: James May's Man Lab
videos.description: James May helps modern man reacquire vital skills that are in danger of being lost as he learns how to defuse an unexploded bomb, build a concrete kitchen and serenade a woman.

videos.title: James May's Man Lab
videos.description: James May helps modern man reacquire vital skills as he navigates the high seas the old-fashioned way, engages in a duel over a parking space, and builds a pub.

videos.title: Abandoned Engineering
videos.description: Claustrophobic prison cells that contain a story worthy of international acclaim, and a vast mountainside complex that held the power to change the world.

videos.title: Adolf Hitler's War
videos.description: The Red Army develops strength and Hitler's Spring Offensive is stopped at Stalingrad; and in the largest ghetto the inhabitants' fight back in the Warsaw Uprising.

videos.title: Adolf Hitler's War
videos.description: In Kursk, a 'battlefield' the size of Wales, the tide turns, and the Soviet's push back, but as Germany retreats, they destroy all evidence of their genocidal activities.

videos.title: Adolf Hitler's War
videos.description: Hitler's War moves to its endgame as the Soviets cross the German border - with a death toll of over 40 million, a new, scarred Europe will emerge.

videos.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
videos.description: Charting the evolution of Auschwitz concentration camp and the mentality of its perpetrators. This episode looks at the camp's beginnings.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo travels from the seaside resort of Hornsea, to Spurn Point, where he learns about a life-saving 19th-century invention.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo reaches Lincolnshire, where his coastal railway journey ends. In Grimsby Town, he investigates a new stage in the town's history.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo heads to Northern Ireland's Causeway coast beginning a new journey along the north and east coasts through Ulster and Leinster.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo visits a museum in Belfast Lough telling the story of Ireland's railway heritage and learns of the important role of Carrickfergus.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo makes his way from Bangor to Belfast, along the way enjoying live music on a boat and visiting the parliament building at Stormont.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo makes his way from the vast beaches of the Carlingford Peninsula to the capital of the Republic of Ireland, Dublin.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo travels from the capital of the Republic of Ireland, Dublin, on the DART suburban railway to the harbour town of Dun Laoghaire.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo travels across Dorset, beginning in Portland Harbour, the location for the 2012 Olympic sailing events.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo visits Dorset's Jurassic Coast. He heads through Swanage, Poole and Sandbanks, before ending his journey on Brownsea Island.

videos.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
videos.description: Michael Portillo heads from Southampton to the Isle of Wight, where he rides the island's railway, made up of recycled London Underground trains.
